description: During weeks seven and eight of the 2026 legislative session, my House colleagues and I continued our work at the Georgia State Capitol. Much of our time was spent in committee meetings reviewing and discussing legislation before it heads to the House floor. These workdays are an important part of the process and allow us to take a closer look…
